rubric.description: For project planning, preserve accepted project agreements in docs/project.md, linking existing detailed sources when useful, and keep proposals distinct from accepted commitments. When a release is being planned, keep its audience, selected work, version and readiness questions in a separate document under docs/releases/ and link the project versioning policy rather than duplicating it. An effort status or feature ticket alone is insufficient for shared project or release decisions. Do not invent platform commitments, require unrelated release planning for routine work, or treat missing observations as proof an action did not occur.
